title: Optimize RAM
name: optimize-ram
description: Fixed pagefile sized from your RAM. Just pick your memory size and hit Apply.
deepDescription:
Sets one fixed paging file so Windows stops resizing it mid-game:

- **Initial = RAM / 8**, **Maximum = 3 x RAM capped at 16 GB**.
- Kernel is automatically kept in RAM on 16 GB+ systems.

Just confirm your memory size (auto-detected when possible) and hit Apply. Restart required.
warning: Restart Windows for the new memory settings to take effect.
